name: io.github.zyvorai/paqtra
title: Paqtra
description: Read-only Cilium and Hubble network observability and flow investigation for Kubernetes.

environmentVariables.name: PAQTRA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Paqtra API, for example https://paqtra.example:9191.

environmentVariables.name: PAQTRA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: JWT bearer token for the Paqtra API. Alternative to PAQTRA_USERNAME and PAQTRA_PASSWORD.

environmentVariables.name: PAQTRA_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Paqtra user to log in as when PAQTRA_TOKEN is not set. A read-only role is enough.
